_source: ProM's own project communications, no architecture document exists for 6.9: H.M.W. Verbeek's ProM 6 announcement (AISWorld list, 2010-11-27) and ProM forum answers on contexts and the jar layout (promforum.win.tue.nl). Package and class names removed. Written and frozen before any ProM run; the SAEroCon architecture file for ProM was not read (it holds the mapping).
prom.framework: The ProM 6 framework: a generic, pluggable toolkit that knows nothing about process mining; it only sees objects, actions, views and their classes, manages the plug-ins and packages, and can distribute plug-in execution over several computers
prom.domain.contexts: Contexts: a plug-in's connection to the framework, giving access to the user interface (messages, cancellation, progress), to the relations between objects, and to the package manager for calling other plug-ins; the user interface a person starts lives here
prom.domain.models: Models: the objects plug-ins work on and show, such as process models, data models and social networks; detailed knowledge of these classes stays out of the framework
prom.domain.plugins: Plug-ins: implement the actions and views on objects
